recipes.intention: Call a service that requires a credential and scopes (authorization client)
primitives: generated client: registerItemsClient(app), resolved with endpoint().inject()
antiPatterns: A hand-written client class that sets the Authorization header itself
A custom middleware that parses credentials instead of authenticate()
Credential header names repeated in consumer code instead of the provider's credential profiles

recipes.intention: Generate a typed HTTP client for a provider service
antiPatterns: A fetch wrapper with request and response types copied by hand
An edit inside a generated clients/ tree instead of a regeneration
A base URL, header or retry interceptor written in the consumer

recipes.intention: Run tests against a real database
primitives: infra/requirements.json databases entry (putnami test provisions the binding)
antiPatterns: A per-project database test helper that hardcodes a connection string or starts its own container
A test that opens a raw driver connection instead of the default datasource

recipes.intention: Serve a server-rendered route with an interactive island
primitives: @putnami/web: page files under src/app/ with loader() and useLoaderData()
antiPatterns: Client-side fetching in a page for data a loader can provide
A whole page hydrated to make one widget interactive
A hand-written form handler without a CSRF input
Schema DDL run from application startup code
A hand-rolled migrations table or runner
A polling loop or an in-process emitter between features
An untyped payload parsed by hand in the subscriber
